[4:36PM] #Okota_Isolo #TrafficUpdate  

Movement from Cele, the stretch leading towards Pako and the return journey is fast. Similarly, Ago Palace Road is experiencing free movement for both inbound and outbound traffic around Apple Junction.

 Motorists traveling from Nwachukwu Drive towards Cele will find conditions favorable in both directions. The Cele linked bridge heading towards Ijesha is also clear for both inbound and outbound travel. 

Within Ire Akari, the inner roads connecting to Osolo Road are currently without traffic impediments in either direction. On Ibeh Road, Apata, the route from Transformer Junction to the Ilasa under bridge service lane is moving well for both inbound and outbound journeys.

 Oke Afa, specifically the stretch towards the Lasutech roundabout, has good traffic flow in both directions. Furthermore, Daleko bridge inbound towards Palm Avenue junction is clear, as is the return route. 

Finally, Five Stars, encompassing both the main carriageways and service lanes towards Ijesha express, is presently experiencing unimpeded traffic flow with no reported issues.

#FollowLASTMA
